I_ACCESS.description: Users report login failures, account entry errors, token messages, and repeated requests for a new contact number.

I_BILLING.description: Users report premium barriers, pricing concerns, payment or sign-up failures, missing paid access, and restrictions on free downloads.

I_CATALOG.description: Users report missing songs, podcasts, or lyrics, along with dissatisfaction with recommendations and repetitive DJ selections.

I_DOWNLOADS.description: Users report stalled or unavailable downloads, deleted saved content, storage-transfer failures, and downloaded media remaining inaccessible offline.

I_OTHER.description: Users express general dissatisfaction, particularly with missing features, empty app experiences, and recent updates.

I_PLAYBACK.description: Users report interrupted or incorrect playback, playlist failures, connectivity problems, poor performance, and blank screens.

I_USABILITY.description: Users report removed or hard-to-find controls, mobile navigation restrictions, and frequent advertising interruptions.
